explained.title: Which differences have an observable explanation?
rows: Loading variation by employee universe and source vintage [[CMP-07]]
1.454667 full-time private industry, June 2024; 1.4582 transportation/material-moving source, March 2023.
Different cited populations and periods explain why the ratios differ. This does not establish that each proxy is optimal; domestic paragraph also has a month-label ambiguity.
0.5 minute Federal threat triage versus 5 minutes contractor read/respond.
Source separates security triage from reading and selecting a response template. Different task boundaries explain the values.
Source explicitly moves certification questions online and removes duplicative interview questions. This explains the task deletion, not a fully reconciled numerical Item 15 bridge.
Recent Item 15 cites user-experience feedback as basis. Published explanation supports changed estimate; underlying timing sample is not public.
Contractor Federal cost removed and candidate $150 per exam added for 18,000 exams.
Statement explicitly assigns local examination cost to candidates. Payer change explains category movement; no claim of net savings.
Source defines resubmission as incremental 25% of initial effort; not a mutually exclusive initial path.
TRIP form time revised using user experience [[CMP-24]]
Current Item 15 attributes the reduction to user experience. Underlying timing sample remains unavailable; this supports explanation, not measured universal completion time.
SSI bidder CHRC pathway includes additional activities [[CMP-25]]
15 minutes without CHRC versus 116 minutes with CHRC.
With-CHRC pathway includes fingerprinting and travel/wait omitted from the no-CHRC pathway. Scope explains the different total durations.
explained.note: Source: eight adjudicated task/method comparisons. Published explanations do not independently validate actual task performance.

unresolved.title: What evidence would resolve the six open comparisons?
rows: Airport obligation includes development, submission and implementation; timed paragraph does not decompose preparation. Carrier paragraph isolates request documentation. Public text does not establish equal complexity or full task boundaries.
Decompose preparation, submission and implementation for aligned amendment types.
Coordinator contact updates across surface and pipeline collections [[CMP-05]]
Both cover updates, but pipeline cardinality and task detail are not decomposed; one operator event may encompass more work than one person contact.
Align persons, coordinator/alternate bundles, fields and operator events.

Different studies visibly explain source selection. Primary Altarum brief describes diary-day travel rather than explicitly one-way travel; TSO doubling needs clarification. FAMS source surveys adults aged 50+, not a measured applicant sample.
Establish one-way/round-trip statistic, travel purpose and applicant-population fit.
TWIC reports pilot completion faster than its retained conservative estimate. PreCheck separately models conditional biometric submission; common credential labels do not prove equal form content.
Align form content, conditional biometrics and timing evidence.

IAC converts fifteen days into 120 hours without decomposition and pools TSA-issued and industry-requested amendments. FAC separately describes research/drafting and headquarters review. Identical case complexity and staffing are not established.
Decompose active work by role and amendment type; establish pooled scope.
Coordinator turnover models have different denominators [[CMP-21]]
No aligned pipeline person-stock denominator or shared empirical calibration is established. Do not form a numeric ratio; retain method-selection question.
Align person-stock and operator-event denominators; provide annual calibration.
